questions.question: How many triangles are there in the given figure?
questions.questionHtml: How many triangles are there in the given figure?
questions.solution:
Concept Used:

 \(Triangles = n× {{n + 1} \over2}×H \)
Where, 
n= number of small triangles
H = number of ‘end to end’ horizontal lines

→ In, ∆ABC:

n= number of small triangles = 2
H = number of ‘end to end’ horizontal lines = 4 (BC, HI, FG, and DE)

\(Triangles = 2× {{2 + 1} \over2}×4 = 12 \)
Hence, Total triangles in ∆ABC = 12

→ In, ∆AJC:

n= number of small triangles = 1
H = number of ‘end to end’ horizontal lines = 2 (AC, LK)

\(Triangles = 1× {{1 + 1} \over2}×2 = 2 \)
Hence, Total triangles in ∆AJC = 2

→ In, ∆NLJ:

n= number of small triangles = 2
H = number of ‘end to end’ horizontal lines = 1 (NJ)

\(Triangles = 2× {{2 + 1} \over2}×1 = 3\)
Hence, Total triangles in ∆NLJ = 3

→Now, triangles formed due to joining shapes= 3(∆BOJ, ∆BCJ, ∆NJK)

→ Now Adding all the ∆s:
Total ∆s = 12 + 2 + 3 + 3 = 20

Hence, “20” is the correct answer.

questions.question: The total of the ages of Amit and Suvarna on 1 January 2015 is 61 years. Amit is three years younger than Suvarna. What was the age of Suvarna on 1 January 2010?
questions.questionHtml: The total of the ages of Amit and Suvarna on 1 January 2015 is 61 years. Amit is three years younger than Suvarna. What was the age of Suvarna on 1 January 2010?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

Total ages of Amit and Suvarna on January 1st 2015 is 61 years.

Let the age of Amit be ‘x’ and Suvarna be ‘y’.

x + y = 61

Amit is three years younger than Suvarna

x = y – 3

Substituting it in ‘x + y = 61’

y – 3 + y = 61

2y – 3 = 61

2y = 64

y = 32

So,

Suvarna’s age = 32 and Amit’s age = 32 – 3 = 29

Suvarna’s age on 1st January 2010 is 32 – 5 = 27 years

Hence, “27 years” is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "occurred". 

Key Points

  • The sentence reads: "Believe it or not, the first recorded watermelon harvest nearly 5000 years ago in Egypt and is depicted in Egyptian hieroglyphics on the walls of their buildings."
  • The word "occurred" means "to happen or take place".
  • In this context, it is referring to the first recorded watermelon harvest.
  • The other options are not as appropriate.

    • "Discovered" means "to find or learn something for the first time", which is not what the sentence is about.
    • "Produced" means "to make or create something", which is also not what the sentence is about.
  • Therefore, the best option to fill in blank 2 is "occurred".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. Martin drew a picture of the snow-capped mountains.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.
Martin drew a picture of the snow-capped mountains.

options.text: A picture of the snow-capped mountains has been drawn by Martin.
options.html: A picture of the snow-capped mountains has been drawn by Martin.

options.text: A picture of the snow-capped mountains is being drawn by Martin.
options.html: A picture of the snow-capped mountains is being drawn by Martin.

options.text: A picture of the snow-capped mountains was drawn by Martin.
options.html: A picture of the snow-capped mountains was drawn by Martin.

options.text: A picture of the snow-capped mountains is drawn by Martin.
options.html: A picture of the snow-capped mountains is drawn by Martin.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. A picture of the snow-capped mountains was drawn by Martin.

The original sentence is in the active voice, the format for that is:

Subject + Verb in the Simple Past + Object

This needs to be converted to the passive voice, the format for that will be 

Object + was + Verb in the Past Participle + by + Subject

A picture of the snow-capped mountain      was     drawn      by       Martin

Thus, the correct answer is option 3.

questions.question: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order. A. He then called out to the people but by then only a red glow was visible in the sky. B. At first, he thought it was a stuck kite. C. Bheema was visiting his fields when he spotted a rising disc shaped object. D. But when it started rising higher and emitted light, he was shocked.
questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.
A. He then called out to the people but by then only a red glow was visible in the sky.
B. At first, he thought it was a stuck kite.
C. Bheema was visiting his fields when he spotted a rising disc shaped object.
D. But when it started rising higher and emitted light, he was shocked.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. CBDA

The passage begins with an introduction to the topic at hand, statement C, which talks about how 'Bheema' was visiting fields when he spotted a disc shaped object. Then comes statement B, this talks about what Bheema's first reaction was at seeing the object, then comes statement D which talks about how his perception changes when the disc rises higher. Finally comes statement A which talks about what Bheema does on realizing that the object was not what he thought.

Thus, the correct answer is option 3.

B. Truly strong personalities meet challenges of life bravely and face hardships with
equanimity.
C. However, strength of character is a personality trait or a quality.

The passage begins with the sentence D at hand, which introduces the topic - Physical strength is the ability to cope with a physically challenging task, this is followed by statement A which talks about how physical strength requires physical endurance and it can be built with training and exercise. Then comes statement C which talks about strength of character is a personality trait. Finally comes statement B which talks about strong personalities meet challenged bravely and face hardships.

Thus, the correct answer is option 4.
